steps: Inspected existing RoundLoop/EnemyTemplate to build a DISTINCT lane-based concept
Authored ReplicatedStorage.GauntletConfig: escalating waves defined by perLane/activeLanes/health/speed/damage across 4 lane directions
Authored ServerScriptService.GauntletRounds: spawns EnemyTemplate clones down active lanes as advancing columns
Wave-cleared detection via a live alive-counter decremented on Humanoid.Died; VICTORY printed after final wave
Disabled the pre-existing RoundLoop so only the Gauntlet lifecycle runs
Verified both scripts compile, config loads, template has PrimaryPart+Humanoid

recipe.text: Config-driven Gauntlet round system in the RoundLoop family. GauntletConfig lists ordered escalating waves; each spawns wave.perLane enemies in wave.activeLanes lane directions, stacked back along each lane so waves read as columns. GauntletRounds clones the shared EnemyTemplate, sets per-wave hp/speed/damage, and resolves each wave only when all spawned Humanoids fire Died (real combat, no auto-kill). After the last wave it declares VICTORY. All lifecycle events (SYSTEM START, wave START/SPAWN/CLEARED, VICTORY) print with the [Gauntlet] tag and mirror to Workspace attributes; it waits for a player before starting.
